arStrings.szText: My boots are soaked. Some kind of rash is creeping up my arm. And all I hear at night are the voices of the dead.
Trying to act like he's all right, but inside he feels guilty about what happened to Neyrelle.
I keep thinking about the last time we were here. There were more of us, for one. We were hunting Lilith and now we hunt her father.
